reviews.author: Mackenzie B…
reviews.body: I had found Elaine on a whim when I desperately needed a haircut and since she was close to home I decided to give her a shot lol. I am extremely happy with how my hair came out, and love that she has hair tinsel available because I’ve always wanted to try it (and I LOVE IT!!). She was super personable, easy to talk to, and did a great job with my hair. I would 100% recommend others to come to her and get their hair done; and I’m sure she will be seeing me again:)

reviews.author: Haley F…
reviews.body: Elaine has been cutting my hair for years, and she is the absolute best! I recommend her to everyone 😊
